Classic 60 fact sheet: up to 8% off tariff (3% + 5% prompt payment)

plans.name: Savvy Saver 24

promo.title: Payback deal: S$228 rebate on 3rd-month bill (first 100)

plans.notes: Fact sheet re-read 19 Oct (same version as last week); price unchanged. New PAYBACK DEAL (GETBACK24, S$228, 15 Oct–31 Dec 2026, first 100) is now the largest rebate with no card condition; YUU24 / MBBON140 / BONUSFLY24 also listed.
plans.evidence: Fixed price plan: 29.00¢/kWh (Rate excl. 9% GST is 26.605¢/kWh)

plans.name: Stack It Up 24

promo.title: Payback deal: S$228 rebate on 3rd-month bill (first 100)

plans.notes: Fact sheet re-read 19 Oct (same version as last week); price unchanged. New PAYBACK DEAL (GETBACK24, S$228, 15 Oct–31 Dec 2026, first 100) is now the largest rebate with no card condition; YUU24 / MBBON140 / BONUSFLY24 also listed.
plans.evidence: Fixed-price plan based on usage per billing period: (i) Stack 1 - First 300 kWh @29.20¢/kWh (ii) Stack 2 - Usage between 301 to 600 kWh @28.60¢/kWh (iii) Stack 3 - Above 600 kWh @27.60¢/kWh (Rates excl. 9% GST are 26.788¢/kWh, 26.24¢/kWh and 25.32¢/kWh respectively)

plans.evidence: Peak/off-peak fixed-rate plan: (i) 33.00¢/kWh during peak periods from 7 am to 11 pm (Day) (ii) 23.00¢/kWh during off-peak periods from 11 pm to 7 am (Night) (Rates excl. 9% GST are 30.275¢/kWh and 21.10¢/kWh).
